# Checklist

- [ ] Entry follows the format: `- [Name](link) - Description.`
- [ ] Entry is placed alphabetically within its section
- [ ] Table of contents updated (if adding a section)
- [ ] Project implements standard OpAMP (no proprietary protocols)
- [ ] Link resolves and points to the canonical project page
- [ ] Description is one line, sentence case, ends with a period
